name: Question 1
problem: A bicycle tire has a pressure of $6\,\text{psi}.$ It is being inflated, and the pressure is increasing at a rate of $4t\,\text{psi}$ per second, where $t$ is a time, in seconds, since the start of the inflation. The tire has a slow puncture that reduces pressure at a rate of $(t+2)\,\text{psi}$ per second. Identify an expression for $P(t),$ the total pressure in the tire at any time $t\ge 0.$

html:
Question 1
?

A bicycle tire has a pressure of 6psi. It is being inflated, and the pressure is increasing at a rate of 4tpsi per second, where t is a time, in seconds, since the start of the inflation. The tire has a slow puncture that reduces pressure at a rate of (t+2)psi per second. Identify an expression for P(t), the total pressure in the tire at any time t≥0.

a
P(t)=32t2−2t+6
b
P(t)=6t2−2t+6
c
P(t)=32t2−2t+4
d
P(t)=6t2−2t+4
e
P(t)=32t2+2t+6
